Martin '''"dryg"''' Andersson is an old-school [[Quakeworld]] player who first started playing in [[1997]]. He mostly played [[CTF]]. dryg started playing in the CTF clan [[U:Clan]] where U:Know taught him how to play with the mouse. Inverted mouse has always been the way he played his [[FPS]] games throughout the years. He played with [[NEC]], [[Hate]] (H8), and [[Hellraisers]]. His last games were played in [[2004]] when he transitioned to Counterstrike. 

dryg started playing again in April [[2024]] after more than 20 years and is one of the team captains for the [[CTF Showdown 3]].
